title: A name for today
caption: Noor opens Waypoint and meets her name for today. It changes tomorrow. The founder tells her story.
linkedin_text: After one onboarding question, Waypoint shows the member a generated name and avatar for the day, with a link to customize it. A one-time opt-in schedules a single quiet reminder for when the next name arrives.

cast.noor: Noor, a young woman with a short wavy bob, round glasses and a teal scarf

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera on a sunny cafe terrace, a relaxed smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Noor's story. She just downloaded Waypoint, and she does not want to be known.
scenes.sub: Hi. This is Noor's story. She just downloaded Waypoint, and she does not want to be known.
scenes.title: A name for today

scenes.clip: {noor} sitting on a park bench with her phone, a hesitant curious look, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: After one question, Waypoint gives her a name made for today.
scenes.sub: After one question, Waypoint gives her a name made for today.

scenes.clip: {noor} looking at her phone with a surprised smile, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: It changes tomorrow, so nobody will recognise her.
scenes.sub: It changes tomorrow, so nobody will recognise her.

scenes.clip: {noor} tapping her phone thoughtfully, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: She can customise the name and the avatar, if she likes.
scenes.sub: She can customise the name and the avatar, if she likes.

scenes.clip: {noor} smiling at a small notification on her phone, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: And she can ask for one quiet reminder when her new name arrives.
scenes.sub: And she can ask for one quiet reminder when her new name arrives.

scenes.clip: {noor} walking through the park in the evening light, relaxed, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Nothing else. Just a name, and a place to say it once.
scenes.sub: Nothing else. Just a name, and a place to say it once.

scenes.vo: Waypoint. Say it once. Free on Google Play, in many Indian and international languages.
